description: The bar chart illustrates the sample count for two categories—Open and Cons.—across four different essay genres: Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository. The vertical axis represents the sample count, ranging from 0 to 120, while the horizontal axis lists the essay genres. For each genre, two bars are displayed side by side: a light blue bar representing "Open" and a pink bar representing "Cons." The values above each bar indicate the sample count. In the Argumentative genre, the Open category has a sample count of 79, and the Cons. category has 122. In the Narrative genre, the Open category has 80 samples, and the Cons. category has 87. In the Descriptive genre, the Open category has 68 samples, and the Cons. category has 100. In the Expository genre, the Open category has 62 samples, and the Cons. category has 130. The chart shows that the Cons. category consistently has a higher sample count than the Open category across all four genres.
